title: The Signature Career Skills Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Skills, proficiency levels, assessment methods, and learning resources. The Career Skills Database catalogs career skills with proficiency-level definitions, how each skill is assessed by employers, and learning resources for building it. Skills span technical, analytical, communication, and leadership categories. The Signature side adds self-assessment rubrics and 30-day skill-building plans per skill.

body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout.
